description:
Tiger sharks in the Bahamas have led scientists to one of the biggest seagrass habitats on Earth. But why is seagrass important? 

🪸 They support ocean biodiversity 
🏝️ Protect coastlines from storms 
🌊 Absorb carbon from the water 

Watch the full film as James Stewart explores more ways people are protecting seagrass habitats.
